date_inferred_from: Breyer's copy of the servitudes of Łazińsk, written directly after his copy of the liquidation table of Łazińsk of 29 June 1868; the liquidation tables set out the peasants' servitudes.
text:
Всѣ крестьяне селенiя Лазинскiй
Голендры имѣютъ право:
1) пасти весь свой [паленный?] скотъ
въ лѣсу „Студзiанки"
2) собирать въ томъ же лѣсу
два раза въ недѣлю сбиранину
состоящую изъ лежанины
и сухихъ вѣтвей; собранное
уносить [тлахтами?].
Болѣе никакихъ правъ на
сервитуты крестьяне не
имѣютъ.
—o—

translation.en:
All the peasants of the village of the Łazińsk
Hollanders have the right:
1) to graze all their [uncertain: paleny] cattle
in the forest "Studzianki";
2) to gather in the same forest
twice a week fallen wood

consisting of lying wood
and dry branches; to carry
what is gathered away [uncertain: by tlakhty].
The peasants have no other
rights to servitudes
whatever.
—o—

summary_en: Albert Breyer's Russian copy of the servitudes of the peasants of Łazińsk, written in the notebook directly after his copy of the liquidation table of Łazińsk of 1868. All the peasants of the village of the Łazińsk Hollanders have the right to graze all their cattle in the forest "Studzianki" and to gather there twice a week fallen wood, lying wood and dry branches, and carry it away; they have no other rights to servitudes. The copy carries no date.
summary_de: Albert Breyers russische Abschrift der Servitute der Bauern von Łazińsk, im Heft unmittelbar nach seiner Abschrift der Liquidationstabelle von Łazińsk von 1868. Alle Bauern des Dorfes der Łazińsker Holländer haben das Recht, ihr ganzes Vieh im Wald „Studzianki“ zu weiden und dort zweimal in der Woche Leseholz, liegendes Holz und trockene Äste, zu sammeln und fortzutragen; andere Rechte auf Servitute haben sie nicht. Die Abschrift trägt kein Datum.
